svg.title: CuPGeo — architecture and module details
svg.desc: Paper-aligned vector schematic: DINOv3 with LoRA and Pyramid-FPN feed a segmentation head and VRA. VRA corrects cup logits before cup-preserving disc composition. Soft-vCDR uses predicted and source-mask vertical moments during training. Stop-gradient acts only on the cup-to-disc branch. Solid gray arrows denote forward computation, blue arrows prediction, dashed terracotta arrows supervision, and dotted links module expansion. All images and probability maps are schematic vectors.

g.text: Localize the cup with a bounded vertical prior.
Preserve cup probability; complete the disc.
SG on cup → disc path during training only
Match vertical proportion during source training.
